 The Sydney Sixers have named an unchanged 13-player squad for tomorrow's First Nations Match clash with the Perth Scorchers at North Sydney Oval. 
The match shapes as a blockbuster top-of-the-table battle, with first place on the line when the competition's two leading sides meet from 3.30pm AEDT.
The Sixers will be looking to continue their strong form on home soil as they take on the reigning champions in what promises to be one of the marquee matches of the WBBL season.
 Timings 
 Box Office Opens: 2:15pm
Gates Open: 2:30pm
Sydney Sixers v Perth Scorchers: 3:30pm
